liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (4 reviews): Finds the Dark Star weak, with too many quiet, creepy stretches; Only one verse, harsh feedback, no Feelin' Groovy chaser, and a weak Phil solo [10][11][12][21]
- **Box Of Rain** (3 reviews): Reviewer calls Box of Rain a particular treat, alongside good Bird Song and Playing in the Band; Called Phil's best Box of Rain [10][13][20]
- **Tomorrow Is Forever** (1 review, 1 other source): Dolly Parton song, a rare treat; vocals perhaps slightly off but heartfelt; Preceded by a Stars and Stripes Forever tuning [1][11]
- **Around And Around** (2 reviews): Notes odd lyrics in Around and Around; Reviewer says to enjoy the unusual lyrics in Around and Around [12][13]
- **Stars And Stripes Forever tuning** (1 review): Keith plays a bit of Stars and Stripes Forever after Box of Rain [11]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Singled out as a highlight, along with Around and Around and the inventive tunings [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-11-19.123577.sbd.gans-miller.flac24** (recommended): soundboard; 30 songs; 201 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd72-11-19.sbd.winters.17705.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 191 min; rated 4.24/5 by 17 [7]. Said about its sound: Some songs are marred by cuts in the recording with nothing spliced into the gaps; Recording levels are very low, causing hiss when boosted; first couple of songs nearly unlistenable; Soundboard recording sounds very good, but the first two songs of the concert are missing [10][15][16]
- **gd1972-11-19.sbd.lai.3910.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 189 min; rated 4/5 by 6 [9]. Said about its sound: This copy sounds better than any earlier copy the reviewer had; Sound adjustments occur during Bertha, and minor digital noise appears at the end of Jack Straw [9][20]
- **gd1972-11-19.123578.sbd.gans-miller.flac16**: soundboard; 30 songs; 201 min; rated 4.8/5 by 5 [2]

## Around the show

- Tuning jokes include Nickelodeon before Playin' and Dixie before Dark Star [1]
- Reviewer finds 1972 less exploratory than other years, with better shows from this year; Dark Star seen as boring [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-11-19.123577.sbd.gans-miller.flac24**: taped by David Gans; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Recording Info: SBD -> Master Reel -> Reel (7.5ips 2 track/Dolby B); Transfer Info: Reel (Dolby B Decoded) -> WAV (24bit/96k); Mastering Info: WAV (24bit/96k)… [1]
- **gd72-11-19.sbd.winters.17705.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [7]
- **gd1972-11-19.sbd.lai.3910.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Mike Lai; source: Soundboard [9]. Also: Dat lent by Dr Bruce Fried; transferred and seeded to etree by Mike Lai [9]
- **gd1972-11-19.123578.sbd.gans-miller.flac16**: taped by David Gans; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Recording Info: SBD -> Master Reel -> Reel (7.5ips 2 track/Dolby B); Transfer Info: Reel (Dolby B Decoded) -> WAV (24bit/96k); Mastering Info: WAV (24bit/96k)… [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Bob Marks Grateful Dead: [1972-11-19 Hofheinz Pavilion, Houston, TX, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1972-11-19-hofheinz-pavilion-houston-tx-usa/) [23]
